name: rotating-text
title: Rotating Text
description: One word in a headline that changes every few seconds ("Build for [teams / founders / students]"). It is a familiar pattern done carefully: the line never jumps, a screen reader hears the sentence once, and the reader can stop it.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/rotating-text

Installed to `components/ui/effects/rotating-text.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/rotating-text';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/rotating-text

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
